content: Look upon this fleeting world as a dream at night; awake, O traveler, and claim your immortal heritage.
author: Kabir
explanation: When a false relationship, superficial prestige, or fragile assumption crumbles, do not despair. The removal of a counterfeit is the beginning of genuine reality.
practicalInsight: Reframe a recent loss or disappointment today as the necessary shedding of an illusion.
reflectionPrompt: What loss in my life was actually a disguised liberation?
